mapName: A Learnable Meta - USA State Highway Markers

metas.name: Alabama Highway Sign
metas.note: The Alabama Highway Sign can be somewhat easily recognized as it just has the shape of the state.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Alaska Highway Sign
metas.note: The Alaska Highway Sign can be easily recognized by the stars on the sign resembling the stars on the flag, as well as the word "Alaska" being written on top of the Sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Arizona Highway Sign
metas.note: The Arizona Highway Sign can be easily recognized by the shape of the state being printed on the sign, as well as the word "Arizona" being at the top of the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Arkansas Highway Sign
metas.note: The Arkansas Highway Sign is somewhat easy recognizable by the shape of the state being printed on the Sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: California Highway Sign
metas.note: The California Highway Sign is very easy recognizable by the distinct green colour and shape as well as having "California" written on top of the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Colorado Highway Sign
metas.note: The Colorado Highway Sign is very easily recognizable as its the only Highway Sign to have the State Flag on top of it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Connecticut Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Connecticut Highway Sign only consists of a white Sign with the Roadnumber.

NOTE: -the same sign can be found in Maine, Massachusetts and West Virginia
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Delaware Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Delaware Highway Sign consists of a white Circle on a black sign.

NOTE: similiar signs can be found in Iowa, Mississippi, New Mexico (on Special Occasion) and New Jersey
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Florida Highway Sign
metas.note: The Florida Highway Sign can easily be recognized by the shape of the state being printed on the sign as well as the name "Florida" being on top of the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Georgia Highway Sign
metas.note: The Georgia Highway Sign can be recognized by the shape of the state being printed on the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Hawaii Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Hawaii Highway Sign can be recognized by the shape on the sign.

Oregon and Virginia both have a similiar sign, but facing downwards.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Idaho Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Idaho Highway Sign can easily be recognized by the shape of the state being printed on top of the sign as well as the name "Idaho" on the bottom of the sign.

Also half the sign is black, so it's easily recognizable from a distance.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Illinois Highway Sign
metas.note: The Illinois Highway Sign only consists of a white plate with the name "Illinois" printed on top. Can be confused with Indiana which looks the same with "Indiana" being written on top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Indiana Highway Sign
metas.note: The Indiana Highway Sign only consists of a white plate with the word "Indiana" written on top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Iowa Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Iowa Highway Sign consists of a white Circle on a black sign.

NOTE: similiar signs can be found in Delaware, Mississippi, New Mexico (on Special Occasion) and New Jersey
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Kansas Highway Sign
metas.note: The Kansas Highway Sign can easily be recognized, as it's the only sign that consists of a yellow circle on top of a black sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Kentucky Highway Sign
metas.note: The Kentucky Highway Sign can easily be confused with the Highway Signs that consist of the white circle on top of the black sign, but the Kentucky Sign has a more ovale shape and isn't a circle.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Louisiana Highway Sign
metas.note: The Louisiana Highway Sign can easily be recognized by the shape of the state on the sign as well as the letters "LA" on top of the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Maine Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Maine Highway Sign only consists of a white Sign with the Roadnumber.

NOTE: -the same sign can be found in Connecticut, Massachusetts and West Virginia
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Maryland Highway Sign
metas.note: The Maryland Highway Sign can easily be recognized by the name "Maryland" on top of the Sign with a distinct black border and the road number underneath.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Massachusetts Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Massachusetts Highway Sign only consists of a white Sign with the Roadnumber.

NOTE: -the same sign can be found in Connecticut, Maine and West Virginia
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Michigan Highway Sign
metas.note: The Michigan Highway Sign can easily be recognized by the diamond shape on the black sign with a big black M at the top. NOTE: It can be confused with the North Carolina Sign, but that lacks the M at the top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Minnesota Highway Sign
metas.note: The Minnesota Highway Sign can easily be recognized by the blue colour and the name "Minnesota" being written on top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Mississippi Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Mississippi Highway Sign consists of a white Circle on a black sign.

NOTE: similiar signs can be found in Delaware, Iowa, New Mexico (on Special Occasion) and New Jersey
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Missouri Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Missouri Highway Sign can be recognized by the shape of the state on the sign.

On supplementaral routes you will find a white sign, with a letter in black in the middle and a black outline. These are found on the map near other highways and are mapped with the respective letter.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Montana Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Montana Highway Sign can be recognized by the black frame and the name "Montana" on top of the sign.

On Secondary roads you will see a white shape resembling a tip of an arrow on a black sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Nebraska Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Nebraska Highway Sign can be recognized by the trapez shape and the name "Nebraska" on top of the sign, as well as a cart at the bottom.

On Secondary Roads, the sign will only show the trapez shape, not the state name on top, or the cart at the bottom.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Nevada Highway Sign
metas.note: The Nevada Highway Sign can be recognized by the shape of the state on the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: New Hampshire Highway Signs
metas.note: The New Hampshire Highway Sign can be recognized by the shape of the state on the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: New Jersey Highway Sign
metas.note:
The New Jersey Highway Sign consists of a white Circle on a black sign.

NOTE: similiar signs can be found in Delaware, Iowa, New Mexico (on Special Occasion) and Mississippi
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: New Mexico Highway Signs
metas.note:
New Mexico Highway Signs can be recognized by the white circle on a black sign with a thin red circle inside the white circle.

NOTE: -the red inner circle isn't always there

      -similiar signs can be found in Delaware, Iowa, Mississippi and New Jersey
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: New York Highway Sign
metas.note: The New York Highway Sign can be recognized by a hexagonal white shape on the black sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: North Carolina Highway Sign
metas.note:
The North Carolina Highway Sign can be recognized by a white diamond shape on a black sign.

NOTE: Michigan has a similiar sign, but has a black M at the top of the diamond.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: North Dakota Highway Sign
metas.note: The North Dakote Highway Sign can be recognized by the shape of the state on the sign as well as the name "North Dakota" on top of the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Ohio Highway Sign
metas.note: The Ohio Highway Sign can be recognized by the shape of the state on the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Oklahoma Highway Sign
metas.note: The Oklahoma Highway Sign can be recognized by a thin outline of the state behind the road number.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Oregon Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Oregon Highway Sign can be recognized by a missshaped circle on the black sign.

NOTE: the same sign can be found in Virginia, but the landscape is very different
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Pennsylvania Highway Sign
metas.note: The Pennsylvania Highway Sign can be recognized by a white trapez with a little extension on top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Rhode Island Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Rhode Island Highway Sign can be recognized by a white sign and the letters "RI" above the road number.

NOTE: a similiar sign can be found in Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts and West Virginia, but in Rhode Island there will always be a "RI" at the top
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: South Carolina Highway Sign
metas.note: The South Carolina Highway Sign can be recognized by a distinct blue Outline, blue road number and the name "South Carolina" as well as a little shape of the state on the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: South Dakota Highway Sign
metas.note: The South Dakota Highway Sign can be recognized by the clear green Outline on the sign forming the shape of the state.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Tennesse Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Tennesse Highway Sign can be recognized by the shape of the state at the bottom and the name "Tennesse" written inside the shape.

On secondary roads, you will find a white triangle pointing downwards on a black sign instead.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Texas Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Texas Highway Sign can be recognized by a slightly thicker black outline and the name "Texas" written at the bottom.

On farm roads you will find a black sign with the shape of texas on top and the words "FARM ROAD" or "RANCH ROAD" written on the sign although these roads may be very hard to find.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Utah Highway Signs
metas.note: The Utah Highway Signs can be recognized by the shape of a bee house on the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Vermont Highway Sign
metas.note: The Vermont Highway Sign can be recognized by the green font and border on the sign as well as the name "Vermont" at the top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Virginia Highway Sign
metas.note:
The Virginia Highway Sign can be recognized by a misshaped white circle on a black sign.

On secondary roads, they use the same White circle on black backround design, like in Delaware, Iowa, Mississippi, New Jersey and Maine.

NOTE: -The same sign can be found in Oregon.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Washington Highway Sign
metas.note: The Washington Highway Sign can be recognized by the white silhouette of George Washington's Head on the sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: West Virginia Highway Sign
metas.note:
The West Virginia Highway Sign can be recognzied by a white sign, often with a black outline.

NOTE: The same sign can be found in Connecticut, Massachusetts and Maine.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Wisconsin Highway Sign
metas.note: The Wisconsin Highway Sign can be recognized by a rounded white rectangle with an extension on top and a little white triangle at the bottom.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.

metas.name: Wyoming Highway Sign
metas.note: The Wyoming Highway Sign can easily be recognized, as it's the only full yellow Highway Sign in the entire USA. In addition it has the name "Wyoming" written at the top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-states for more clues.
